content: 1 A psalme for to confesse. Be ye ioyfull in God all that be in the earth: 2 serue God with gladnesse, and come before his face with a ioyfull noyse. 3 Be ye sure that God is the Lorde, it is he that hath made vs, and not we our selues: we are his people and the sheepe of his pasture. 4 Go your way into his gates with thankesgeuyng, and into his courtes with prayse: be thankfull vnto hym and blesse his name. 5 For God is gratious, his mercie is euerlastyng: and his trueth endureth from generation to generation.
